# AI Lab Consulting

> AI Lab Consulting helps banks, credit unions, insurers and fintechs put AI agents into production with the approvals and records that examiners and auditors expect. Based in Laguna Beach, California.

## Services

- [AI governance assessment](https://ailabconsulting.com/services/governance-assessment/): A fixed-scope review of the AI agents you run, with the gaps mapped to SR 11-7, SOX, DORA and the EU AI Act.
- [Approval and audit architecture](https://ailabconsulting.com/services/agent-authorization/): Every consequential agent action approved by a named person and recorded, enforced where the action runs.
- [Compliant AI-assisted engineering](https://ailabconsulting.com/services/ai-assisted-sdlc/): Your engineers use AI coding tools, and the pipeline keeps the change-control evidence auditors ask for.
- [Fractional AI governance lead](https://ailabconsulting.com/services/fractional-ai-leadership/): Senior AI governance and architecture leadership on retainer, for firms that don't need a full-time hire.

## How we work

1. Assess: A fixed-scope review of your agents and controls, and a ranked list of what to fix.
2. Build: We design and build the controls, starting with one workflow on your data.
3. Hand over: Your team runs it, with the documentation and the evidence trail.
